messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: changes to FirmaModel class
parts:
Hi all.

Just wondering if someone can direct me to how I might go and change
some of the definitions of a 'FirmaModel' class. Specifically, I
want to add an attribute (variable?) in the definition, so that when
fit.FirmaModel gets invoked, I can change what it is currently doing
(or at least give flexibility to do something else).

To date, when I want to try an alternative fit.Something or
process.Something, I just make a local copy and source the new
version ... but how do I do that with a class?

Thanks,
Mark

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] changes to FirmaModel class
parts:
Hi Mark,
You can do the same basic strategy (of course overwriting what's
already there) -- it's just harder to get the definitions of the class
objects. I do this in a round about way by debugging 'FirmaModel'
because it prints out the class function and then 'args' to see the
function call, but there must be a better way to see the code of
functions that are not available. Anyway, doing this, I reconstruct
that the call for FirmaModel is as below. You can see that the only
error catching is that 'summaryMethod' must be a string, so you can
add new options to getUnitFitFunction.FirmaModel, or whatever it is,
and it won't matter. I would note that the default 'tag' is FIRMA, but
you might want a different tag for different summary methods. In
addition, back in the spring, at least, the names of the files that
the scores were saved to were hard coded in the fit function, not
according to the tags (I think), and so I don't know how well the tags
go through the process.

Best,
Elizabeth

setConstructorS3("FirmaModel",function (rmaPlm = NULL, summaryMethod =
"upperQuartile", tags = "*", ...) {
if (!is.null(tags)) {
tags <- Arguments$getCharacters(tags)
tags <- trim(unlist(strsplit(tags, split = ",")))
asteriskTag <- "FIRMA"
tags[tags == "*"] <- asteriskTag
tags <- paste(tags, collapse = ",")
tags <- unlist(strsplit(tags, split = ","))
}
if (!is.character(summaryMethod)) {
throw("Argument 'summaryMethod' must be a string.")
}
extend(UnitModel(..., tags = tags), "FirmaModel", .plm = rmaPlm,
summaryMethod = summaryMethod, "cached:.fs" = NULL)
})

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: changes to FirmaModel class
parts:
Hi,

you may also extend the FirmaModel class into say, MyFirmaModel class
and play with that. Then you modifications will not interfere with
the existing implementation. When you're happy with your new
model/mods, then they can be "lifted" up in the superclass, e.g.

setConstructorS3("MyFirmaModel",function (..., tags=c("*", "my", "tags")) {
extend(FirmaModel(..., tags=tags), "MyFirmaModel",
.myField1 = "foo",
.myField2 = "bar"
)
})

and all methods are inherited. To override a method in FirmaModel, e.g.

setMethodS3("fit", "MyFirmaModel", unction (...) {
...
})

Cheers

Henrik
